“Come closer. I'll read for you.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.

“The Fool. That's you. A lamp, and no idea how you got here.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.

“I'll carry the lamp. You show me the crossing, and we call that a fair trade.”

Vale, the Lamplighter.

“A little space by the lamp, and I'll tell you what I saw in the water. A splendid exchange.”

Pip, a moth.

“The bell is still. The platform is open. You may take your time.”

The keeper of the empty station.

“The kettle is on, and the wool is dry. Your chair is where you left it.”

RATi, host of the cottage.

“The Moon. A door, standing in the water. Locked.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.

“We remember every road that passed beneath us. Sit in the hollow and tell us the way home, slowly.”

Oak, the Tree of Dreams.

“Warm moss. Soft earth. A perfectly respectable place for a nap.”

Grumpy Badger, a badger of the clearing.

“Give up one thing for good, and I will keep it.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.

“A passenger asked me about the goblin at the edge of the shadows. It holds no ticket. Officially, I have not seen it.”

The keeper of the empty station.

“Someone here wants something. Ask them.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.

“The bread is warm. Set your jar by the door, and come sit with us.”

Dione the Baker.

“I have heard two stories today, and I know who told each one.”

The Chorus Elder of Thebes.

“Show me a written order, and I step aside. And if you pass the oven, bring me a crust.”

The Gate Guard of Thebes.

“There is dust on the road, and the wind comes from the field. Bring me a shovel and clean cloth, and I will show you the way.”

Antigone, daughter of Oedipus.

“I looked down the road twice. Nobody is coming. Walk a little ahead of me, and I will tell you the plan as we go.”

Ismene, sister of Antigone.

“The door is open and the bench is clear. Bring your witness and say your name plainly.”

Creon, King of Thebes.

“And this one we don't name.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.

“If you see my sister, tell her I am waiting, and I am not angry.”

Polynices, brother of Antigone.

“The shipmaster says there is a city across the water called Troy. I repeat it as he said it. I have not seen it.”

The Chorus Elder of Thebes.

“Twenty-two cards. Each one costs something.”

The Listener, behind the grille of a box on wheels.
